editorial_thesis: Today’s strongest signal is a shift from agent capability to accountable substrate: event streams, open runtimes, typed extraction, multimodal retrieval, and auditable self-improvement.

topic_groups.title: Event-Driven Agent Execution
topic_groups.selection_rationale: GitHub is turning agent work from polling loops and personal setup into subscribable events, shared plugins, and governed service connectors. The practical move is to make waiting, permissions, and handoffs explicit in the workflow contract.
